fields.rationale: AHB and APB are purely digital, synchronous on-chip bus protocols. Neither spec contains analog signaling, DC electrical specifications, AC timing parameters (Vih/Vil/tsu/th/etc.), nor IO standards (LVCMOS/LVDS/etc.). Both protocols are defined entirely in terms of logical levels sampled on the rising edge of their respective clocks (HCLK for AHB, PCLK for APB).

signaling_summary.ahb_clock: Single HCLK per AHB interface; all bus timings are related to the rising edge of HCLK.
signaling_summary.ahb_reset: Single active-LOW HRESETn. HRESETn is the only active-LOW signal in AHB.
signaling_summary.apb_clock: Single PCLK; all transfers are timed by the rising edge of PCLK.
signaling_summary.apb_reset: Single active-LOW PRESETn. Normally connected directly to the system bus reset signal.
signaling_summary.io_count: All channels are unidirectional in AHB-Lite / AHB5 and APB (no tristate buses, separate HWDATA / HRDATA in AHB).
signaling_summary.signal_naming_convention: All AHB signals are prefixed with H (e.g. HCLK, HADDR, HTRANS). All APB signals are prefixed with P (e.g. PCLK, PADDR, PENABLE). Lower-case 'n' at the start or end of a signal name denotes active-LOW.
signaling_summary.default_state_during_reset: Driving values of bus signals during reset are not explicitly specified by the protocols; integrators typically gate Manager outputs to safe defaults (HTRANS=IDLE, AWVALID=LOW analog equivalents, PSEL=0).

additional_reading_referenced: ARM AMBA APB Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0024)
ARM AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022)

evidence.quote: HCLK Clock source: The bus clock times all bus transfers. All signal timings are related to the rising edge of HCLK. HRESETn Reset controller: The bus reset signal is active LOW and resets the system and the bus. This is the only active LOW signal.

Lower-case n at the start or end of a signal name denotes an active-LOW signal. Prefix H denotes an Advanced High-performance Bus (AHB) signal. Prefix P denotes an Advanced Peripheral Bus (APB) signal.
